pages.text: The $(l)Fletching Table$() is where it all comes together. Bring your $(l)Pliable Limb$(), a $(l)Riser$(), and a $(l)String$() here to assemble a finished bow — or a $(l)Head$(), $(l)Shaft$(), and $(l)Fletching$() to build a modular arrow.

pages.title: Tuning
pages.text: Assembling a bow plays a short $(l)tuning minigame$(). How well you do becomes the bow's $(l)Tuning %$(), shown in green on its tooltip.$(br2)Higher tuning = a $(l)faster draw$(). Same parts, better hands: a quicker bow. It's worth taking your time.
The table is the vanilla Fletching Table — right-click it to open the modular menu. Everything you build starts and ends here.
